newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline rally runs out of steam, but not dead.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline rally runs out of steam, but not dead.

text.p: NWE gasoline lost ground on Friday with prices dipping by up to $4 as U.S. futures stalled after a mini-rally.
But tight stocks on both sides of the Atlantic mean it is too early to say that gasoline has had its summer for this year, traders said.
Public holidays across parts of Europe contributed to a slower market tone and with few signs of this week's gasoline price supporters in evidence the sign was set to shave off some recent gains.
